subject: Reducing the number of Labels in a Legend

messages.author: 029c9bb847a9e034
messages.subject: Reducing the number of Labels in a Legend
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to reduce the number of legend values shown in the legend.
I am working with the mpg dataset, and I have created a "honda"
subset of this data. In this subset only a few "trans" values are
used, but when the plot is created all the potential "trans" values
are shown rather than only the values that are actually plotted. Is
there a way to filter the labels so that they are not shown in the
legend. Below is the code that I used to produce my current output.
Thanks for any help in advance,

-- Adam

<code>


library(ggplot2)

isa_match <- function(data_field, allowed_datum)
{
for (d in allowed_datum){
if (data_field == d){
return (TRUE)
}
}
return (FALSE)
}

subset_by_manu <- function(mpg_data, mpg_brand_filter){
my_mpg_data <- data.frame(mpg_data[0,])
for (i in 1:nrow(mpg_data)){
if (isa_match(mpg_data[i,"manufacturer" ], mpg_brand_filter)){
my_mpg_data <- rbind(my_mpg_data, data.frame(mpg_data[i,]))
}
}
return (my_mpg_data)
}

honda <- subset_by_manu(mpg, c('honda'))

honda_plot <- ggplot()
honda_point <- geom_point( data=honda, mapping = aes(x = cty, y = hwy,
geom="jitter", size=displ, color=trans), )
honda_facet <- facet_grid(fl ~ year)
honda_scale_size <- scale_size( to=c(3,4))


plot <- honda_plot + honda_point + honda_facet + honda_scale_size
print (plot)

</code>

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Reducing the number of Labels in a Legend
parts:
Hi,

ggplot shows all levels of factor.
you can modify the data by:

ggplot(honda, aes(cty, hwy, size = displ, colour = droplevels(trans)),
geom = "jitter") + geom_point() + facet_grid(fl ~ year) +
scale_size(to = c(3, 4))

or before ggploting:

honda$trans <- droplevels(honda$trans)
ggplot(honda, aes(cty, hwy, size = displ, colour = trans), geom =
"jitter") + geom_point() + facet_grid(fl ~ year) + scale_size(to =
c(3, 4))
